skill.name: database-admin
skill.description: Database administration guidance for cloud databases, automation, reliability, security, disaster recovery, monitoring, and cost optimization.
skill.summary: Plan, operate, secure, and optimize modern cloud database systems.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Database teams need reliable plans for uptime, recovery, performance, security, and cost control. This skill helps Claude, Codex, and Claude Code produce practical database architecture and operations guidance.
actual_capabilities: Designs cloud database architectures across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud services.
Creates high availability, backup, recovery, and disaster recovery plans.
Reviews monitoring, alerting, capacity, and performance optimization approaches.
Recommends database security, access control, encryption, auditing, and compliance practices.
Plans automation for provisioning, schema changes, maintenance, and GitOps workflows.
Identifies cost optimization options while preserving availability and performance goals.
limitations: It provides guidance and plans, not direct database administration.
It depends on accurate workload, compliance, and cloud account details from the user.
It cannot verify live metrics, backups, permissions, or billing data without supplied evidence.
It does not replace vendor documentation or formal security and compliance review.

use_cases.title: Design a Reliable Database Platform
use_cases.description: Create a cloud database architecture with replication, backups, monitoring, access controls, and recovery objectives.

use_cases.title: Improve Production Database Operations
use_cases.description: Build runbooks for maintenance, failover, alert response, performance triage, and patch planning.

use_cases.title: Plan Secure Cloud Migration
use_cases.description: Compare migration paths, data synchronization methods, encryption controls, and rollback steps for cloud database moves.

prompt_templates.title: Assess My Database Setup
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of an existing environment.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my database setup and list the most important reliability, security, backup, and monitoring improvements. Ask for missing details before making assumptions.

prompt_templates.title: Create an Operations Runbook
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a database operations runbook for maintenance, backups, failover, alert response, access reviews, and recovery testing. Include owners and validation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Multi-Region Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a multi-region database architecture for my workload. Include replication strategy, RPO, RTO, failover process, consistency tradeoffs, monitoring, and cost risks.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Database Automation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an Infrastructure as Code and GitOps plan for database provisioning, schema migrations, policy checks, maintenance automation, backup verification, and rollback.

output_examples.input: Design disaster recovery for a managed PostgreSQL workload with a one hour recovery point objective.
output_examples.output: A recovery plan with primary and replica topology, backup schedule, failover steps, monitoring checks, recovery tests, ownership, and cost considerations.

output_examples.input: Review database security for a healthcare application before launch.
output_examples.output: A security checklist covering least privilege access, encryption, audit logging, secret rotation, network controls, vulnerability management, and compliance evidence.

output_examples.input: Reduce cloud database cost without missing performance targets.
output_examples.output: A prioritized optimization plan covering right sizing, storage tiers, read replicas, reserved capacity, idle resources, query tuning, and monitoring guardrails.

best_practices: Provide workload size, database engine, cloud provider, compliance needs, and recovery objectives.
Ask for validation steps that prove backups, failover, monitoring, and permissions work.
Review recommendations against vendor limits and your organization policies before production changes.
anti_patterns: Do not request production changes without rollback plans and maintenance windows.
Do not share real credentials, connection strings, customer data, or secret values.
Do not accept a design that lacks backup testing, alerting, access review, or cost controls.

faq.question: What databases does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers relational, NoSQL, NewSQL, time-series, graph, search, cache, and cloud managed database services.

faq.question: Can it administer my database directly?
faq.answer: No. It provides plans, checklists, reviews, and runbooks that a qualified operator can apply.

faq.question: Does it support cloud database services?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud database platforms and migration services.

faq.question: Can it help with compliance requirements?
faq.answer: Yes. It can map database controls to frameworks such as HIPAA, PCI-DSS, SOX, and GDPR.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide database engine, workload profile, traffic patterns, recovery goals, compliance needs, cloud provider, and current pain points.

faq.question: Is it suitable for production incident response?
faq.answer: It can structure triage and recovery steps, but live incidents still need authorized operators with system access.
